description: Look up a single 8-K filing by accession number. Returns full triage row including all Item codes, descriptions, severity, and (if enriched) the LLM-extracted summary. Use after sec_8k_recent / _today / _by_item to get the full structured record for a specific filing. Also reads the filing's own SEC document index (one request) and returns `exhibits` [{type, description, url}] and `primary_exhibit` (the first EX-99.* exhibit, e.g. the earnings press release on an Item 2.02 8-K); a filing with no EX-99 returns primary_exhibit null with primary_exhibit_reason no_ex99_exhibit, and an unreadable index returns exhibits null with exhibits_status unavailable. List tools do not carry exhibits (exhibits_available_via points here).
name: sec_8k_detail

exhibits.description: EX-* documents of the filing; null (never []) when the index could not be read

primary_exhibit.description: First EX-99.* exhibit, or null with primary_exhibit_reason

primary_exhibit_reason.description: Why primary_exhibit is null; null when it is set

primary_exhibit_reason_detail.description: Free text (HTTP status or error message) for the reason, or null

title: Sec 8k Detail
